# T-053 review (stored notifications, e-mail queue, task notes)

Fresh reviewer subagent, no context from the implementer. Report as received, condensed to its findings; what was done about each is under "Fixes".

**Ran:** `bun run check` exit 0 (344 tests); `bun run test:db` 121 tests; a scratch probe: deleting a cottage or an account cascades without a false "declined" notification; a member can't change their own `members.email`.

**Tenancy:** no cross-account read or write found. RLS on all three tables, no anon grants, column-level select on `notifications`, no insert/update grant; members who left lose access; the definer functions require an active member; internal and trigger functions have no execute grant.

| #   | Severity   | Finding                                                                                                                                | Fix                                                                                                                                                                                |
| --- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Medium     | Invitation e-mail can carry attacker-written text (account, cottage and inviter names) to 60 arbitrary addresses per new sign-up a day | `notify_on_invitation`: only from a confirmed sign-in, at most 20 invitation e-mails per account a day, never to the inviter's own address; otherwise stored, not e-mailed. Tested |
| 2   | Low        | `notify_enqueue` not in the allowlist (passes the lint only on the text `auth.uid()`)                                                  | Entry added                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 3   | Low/Medium | The third retry never happened (`email_attempts < 3`)                                                                                  | `MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4`: first try plus three retries (5, 20, 80 min)                                                                                                                   |
| 4   | Low        | A failed DB update after a successful send counted as a send failure                                                                   | Outcome recorded outside the send's try; the idempotency key covers a rerun                                                                                                        |
| 5   | Low        | A cottage-only admin, or an admin on another cottage, gets the e-mail but no list item                                                 | Left as a follow-up (brief, handoff note)                                                                                                                                          |
| 6   | Low        | A stored-notification read error left the list silently short                                                                          | The stored read is part of the page's `failed` state                                                                                                                               |
| 7   | Low        | Institution onboarding invites the founder's own personal e-mail, who would get a system e-mail from themselves                        | Never e-mailed to the inviter's own address                                                                                                                                        |
| 8   | Low        | The rate counter counted per recipient including no-ops                                                                                | Counts only notifications actually stored and meant to be e-mailed                                                                                                                 |
| 9   | Info       | The leaving checklist is captured at handover insert; later edits aren't passed on                                                     | By design                                                                                                                                                                          |
| 10  | Medium     | No PR yet; STATUS, T-005 and the handoff note not updated                                                                              | Done in this commit; PR opened with the check output                                                                                                                               |

Checked and fine: booking delete/update paths and cascades, `decide_guest_request`, links built only from `https://mychata.cz` plus sanitised ids, server-only code reached through dynamic imports, cron route uses the constant-time secret check, a missing table or function before 0038 gives no items and no error. Every changed file is in the brief's allowlist.
